story.iWant: to view and edit customer details

tasks.task: Create page component and fetch customer data
Implement form validation and error handling
Implement save functionality with optimistic locking

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Detail view (read-only mode) shows customer information
Edit button switches to edit mode
Edit mode displays form fields with current values pre-populated
Form validation (real-time feedback): Email valid, Phone valid if provided, Name required 1-100 chars
Save button submits changes (disabled until form is valid)
Cancel button discards changes and returns to read-only mode
Success message on save: "Customer updated successfully" (toast notification, 3s duration)
Error message on failure with details
404 Not Found error if customer doesn't exist
Optimistic locking: if customer was updated by another user, show conflict error
Related Policies section (read-only) with table and "Create New Policy" button
Audit History section (if user has audit_viewer role) showing immutable audit log

doc.title: Epic Breakdown - EPIC 3: React Frontend - Authentication & Core UI
doc.section: Story 3.5: Customer Detail and Edit Page
doc.snippet: Defines customer detail view with edit mode, form validation, related policies display, and audit history for compliance tracking.

doc.title: Story 2.3: Customer Read API (GET /api/v1/customers/{id})
doc.snippet: Defines API response schema including all customer fields, timestamps, and audit info. Frontend displays this data in detail view.

doc.title: Story 2.5: Customer Update API (PUT /api/v1/customers/{id})
doc.section: Backend Update Endpoint with Optimistic Locking
doc.snippet: Defines update endpoint accepting partial updates, etag header for optimistic locking, and audit trail for changed fields.

doc.title: Story 2.8: API Documentation and Audit Logging
doc.snippet: Defines audit query API (GET /api/v1/audit?entity=CUSTOMER) for retrieving immutable audit log entries for compliance verification.

artifact.reason: Story 3.8 implements CustomerService methods: getCustomer(), updateCustomer(). Story 3.5 depends on these for fetch and save operations.
Story 3.7 creates reusable form components (TextInput, EmailInput, PhoneInput, FormError, SuccessAlert). Story 3.5 uses these for edit form.

constraint.rule: Use local state to toggle between detail (read-only) and edit modes. Edit button enters edit mode, Cancel button returns to detail mode.
Real-time validation on field blur/change. Save button disabled if form invalid. Display field-level error messages inline.
Include etag/version in update request. If 409 Conflict returned, show user message: "Customer was updated by another user. Refresh to see latest changes."
Show toast notifications (3s auto-dismiss) for success messages. Show persistent error messages that user must dismiss. Include retry button for transient errors.
If customer not found (404 from API), display user-friendly message: "Customer not found. It may have been deleted." Provide back button to return to search.
Audit History section visible only to users with 'audit_viewer' or 'admin' role. Check user.roles from auth context.

interface.name: CustomerService.getCustomer API
interface.signature: getCustomer(id: string): Promise<Customer> - fetches full customer details including timestamps and created/updated by info
interface.description: Fetches customer data from GET /api/v1/customers/{id} endpoint. Story 3.5 calls this on page load to populate detail view.

interface.name: CustomerService.updateCustomer API
interface.signature: updateCustomer(id: string, data: UpdateCustomerRequest): Promise<Customer> - updates partial customer data with optimistic locking
interface.description: Updates customer via PUT /api/v1/customers/{id}. Includes etag header for optimistic locking. Story 3.5 calls this when user saves changes.

interface.name: useParams Hook
interface.signature: const {customerId} = useParams<{customerId: string}>() - extracts route parameter from /customers/:customerId
interface.description: React Router hook for extracting customerId from URL path. Story 3.5 uses this to know which customer to fetch.

tests.standards: Unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Integration tests verify detail view rendering, edit mode, validation, save/cancel, and error handling. Manual testing for optimistic locking conflict scenarios.

Verify customer details display in read-only format when page loads
Verify Edit button switches page to edit mode
Verify form fields pre-populated with current customer data
Verify real-time field validation; error messages appear/disappear on valid/invalid input
Verify Save button enabled only when form is valid
Verify Cancel button discards changes and returns to read-only mode
Verify success toast message appears after successful update
Verify error message displays on API failure with details
Verify 404 message displays when customer not found; back button navigates to search
